title: Innokin T18E Pro Tank 2ml
description: The Innokin T18E Pro Tank is a versatile and reliable 2ml refillable tank, perfect for vapers seeking a premium mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. Designed by the trusted innovators at Innokin, this tank combines ease of use with outstanding performance. Featuring multiple transparent viewing windows, the T18E Pro Tank allows you to easily monitor your e-liquid levels at a glance. When it’s time to refill, the convenient sliding top-fill design ensures quick, mess-free refills, making this tank an excellent choice for both new and experienced vapers. The T18E Pro Tank is equipped with a 510-threaded connector, making it compatible with a wide range of vape devices. It includes a pre-installed 1.7ohm T18E kanthal coil and an additional 1.5ohm coil, both optimised for delivering smooth vapour, intense flavour, and satisfying clouds. With its durable construction and sleek design, available in Black, Gunmetal, and Stainless Steel, the Innokin T18E Pro Tank offers a reliable and stylish solution for everyday vaping.
